run_nougat_model_evaluation: run the nougat model evaluation on a dataset and compute edit distance, BLEU, and METEOR scores
test_NougatModel_inference: test the NougatModel inference on image tensors and compare predictions against ground truth labels
run_test_with_checkpoint: run the test function with a pretrained checkpoint and dataset to generate predictions and metrics
compute_metrics_multiprocessing: compute metrics using multiprocessing Pool to evaluate predictions against ground truth in parallel
save_evaluation_results: save evaluation results including predictions, ground truths, and accuracy scores to a JSON file
